title: Grouping into a map of slices
hints: The zero value of a missing map[int][]string entry is a nil slice, and append works fine on a nil slice.
So there's no need to check whether a key exists first: groups[k] = append(groups[k], w) both creates and extends.
groups := make(map[int][]string); for _, w := range words { n := utf8.RuneCountInString(w); groups[n] = append(groups[n], w) }; return groups
